integrity: The arity-4 quotient is reconstructed from the two published quadratic identities. An exact rational row reduction proves rank 106 in the 120-dimensional free multilinear space, and the quotient S4-character is computed exactly and decomposed by character inner products. The finite calculation is exhaustive for arity 4 and is not used to claim anything about higher arities.
scientific_limitations: The claim determines only the first defect space in arity 4 and does not present the full higher-arity kernel. The representation decomposition is characteristic-zero; modular behavior is not asserted.
title: The first quadratic-Manin defect of \(\mathrm{Acaa}\) is a \(14\)-dimensional \(S_4\)-module
